intro: MOTION brings movement to your workspace. Designed on the principles of Active Seating, it encourages natural posture shifts, reducing fatigue and keeping you comfortable through long hours at your desk.

features.title: Flexibility that works with you
features.text: With EasyFlex technology, our chair’s precision-engineered material moves with you, reducing stress adding mobility and enhancing comfort—so you feel better, even after hours of sitting.

features.title: Seamless movement for all-day comfort
features.text: The cantilever design of the chair connects the seat with the back. The seat and back therefore flex in sync helping the user in adopting a dynamic range of postures, helping you stay relaxed and supported all day long.

features.title: Recline your way with three tilt options
features.text: Different tasks call for different postures. With the 3-position back tilt limiter, you can easily adjust your recline to match your activity—be it working, reading, or simply taking a break.

features.title: Ergonomics that promote healthy movement
features.text: Static seating is a thing of the past. Our chair’s advanced ergonomic design supports multidimensional movement, helping you stay active and prevent the strain associated with fixed postures.

features.title: Armrests that adjust to your needs
features.text: Everyone sits differently. That’s why this chair features adjustable armrests, allowing you to set the height to your preference—keeping your arms comfortably supported no matter what you’re doing.

name: Motion Full Back Mesh Ergonomic Office Chair Milan Red With White Body
